derivation: Independently authored conservative review policy. This expresses this workbench's contributor workflow, not upstream project policy or language equivalence.
observation_sources: Original GitHub GraphQL response and request retained for each explicit live invocation; no upstream implementation copied.
scope: Five Boolean observations produce a next-review reason. All 32 combinations are checked offline. References can be contextual, history is bounded and lack of a recent sampled merge does not establish inactivity. No decision approves submission or declares unclaimed work.
